peopleAlsoAsk.question: For which viral disease vaccine has been recently developed through the use of tissue culture?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: Advances in tissue culture techniques in the 1950s enabled development of live-attenuated vaccines, which contain a version of the living microbe that has been weakened in the laboratory. The measles, mumps and rubella (MMR) vaccine is one example.
